decision.summary: The Federal Reserve decided to keep the target range for the federal funds rate at 0 to 1/4 percent.

changes.quote: The COVID-19 pandemic is causing tremendous human and economic hardship across the United States and around the world.
changes.explanation: The reference to the virus was updated from coronavirus outbreak to COVID-19 pandemic.

changes.quote: Economic activity and employment have picked up in recent months but remain well below their levels at the beginning of the year.
changes.explanation: The text removed the word somewhat regarding how much activity and employment have picked up.

changes.quote: The ongoing public health crisis will continue to weigh on economic activity, employment, and inflation in the near term, and poses considerable risks to the economic outlook over the medium term.
changes.explanation: The Committee added the word continue to describe the health crisis weighing on the economy.

changes.quote: The Committee seeks to achieve maximum employment and inflation at the rate of 2 percent over the longer run.
changes.explanation: New language was added to explicitly state the Committee's long-run goals for employment and inflation.

changes.quote: With inflation running persistently below this longer-run goal, the Committee will aim to achieve inflation moderately above 2 percent for some time so that inflation averages 2 percent over time and longer-term inflation expectations remain well anchored at 2 percent.
changes.explanation: The statement adds new details about aiming for inflation moderately above 2 percent to average 2 percent over time.

tone_quotes.quote: The ongoing public health crisis will continue to weigh on economic activity, employment, and inflation in the near term, and poses considerable risks to the economic outlook over the medium term.
The Committee expects to maintain an accommodative stance of monetary policy until these outcomes are achieved.

for_you.text: Card rates should not move on this decision; a $5,000 balance at about 14.52% APR costs about $60.50 a month in interest.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 0.69% and moved +1 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 2.93% would rise by about $1.61 a month.
Savings yields should stay roughly where they are, since the Fed held rates.
Unemployment was 8.4%, and employers added an average of 2,594k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 1.3% over the past year (August 2020); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 1.4%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a -28% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved 0 bp on the day, and the S&P 500 moved -0.46%.
The broad trade-weighted dollar moved -0.21% on the day.

whats_next: The statement signals that the Fed intends to maintain low rates until maximum employment is reached and inflation rises to 2 percent and is on track to moderately exceed 2 percent.
